verdicts.reason: A reflows the headline onto one line that suits the banner format, at a strong size and centred with even side margins; it only needs a little more breathing room at the left and right edges. B keeps the portrait two-line break, which leaves the headline small and floating between large empty side areas, so it reads like a shrunken copy of the original instead of a rearranged layout. The two-line stack also wastes the banner's width.
